skills.title: Word documents
skills.name: docx
skills.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.
skills.author: Anthropic

skills.title: PDF
skills.name: pdf
skills.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill.
skills.author: Anthropic

skills.title: PowerPoint
skills.name: pptx
skills.description: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email or summary); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user mentions \"deck,\" \"slides,\" \"presentation,\" or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. If a .pptx or .potx file needs to be opened, created, or touched, use this skill.
skills.author: Anthropic

skills.title: Excel
skills.name: xlsx
skills.description: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like \"the xlsx in my downloads\") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved.

skills.title: Postgres best practices
skills.name: supabase-postgres-best-practices
skills.description: Postgres best practices maintained by Supabase, for Postgres running anywhere. Also load it when diagnosing slow queries, high CPU, timeouts, EXPLAIN plans, connection exhaustion, locking, bloat, or rows visible to the wrong user or tenant. tagline.en: A disciplined loop: plan it, test it first, debug by method, verify before you call it done.
tagline.ar: حلقة عمل منضبطة: خطّط، اختبر أولاً، صحّح بمنهج، وتحقّق قبل أن تقول انتهيت.

why.en: Agents write code fast and confidently wrong. These skills make yours plan before it types, write the failing test first, and prove the fix instead of claiming it.
why.ar: الوكلاء يكتبون الكود بسرعة وبثقة خاطئة. هذه المهارات تجعل وكيلك يخطّط قبل أن يكتب، ويبدأ بالاختبار الفاشل، ويثبت الإصلاح بدل ادّعائه.

tagline.en: Build with models, tools and agents: the Claude API, MCP servers, and skills of your own.
tagline.ar: ابنِ بالنماذج والأدوات والوكلاء: واجهة Claude، وخوادم MCP، ومهارات من صنعك.

why.en: Everything needed to go from calling a model to shipping an agent: current API reference, MCP server patterns, and the tooling to author and find skills.
why.ar: كل ما يلزم للانتقال من استدعاء نموذج إلى إطلاق وكيل: مرجع محدّث للواجهة، وأنماط خوادم MCP، وأدوات لتأليف المهارات والعثور عليها.

tagline.en: React that scales, interfaces that avoid the generic look, motion with a reason.
tagline.ar: React قابل للتوسّع، وواجهات بعيدة عن الشكل النمطي، وحركة لها سبب.

why.en: Front-end work is where agents produce the most convincing slop. These skills hold the line on composition, accessibility and restraint.
why.ar: الواجهات هي المكان الذي ينتج فيه الوكلاء أكثر النتائج إقناعاً وأقلها جودة. هذه المهارات تحافظ على التركيب والإتاحة والانضباط.

tagline.en: Read the web, capture what matters, and keep it in formats you own.
tagline.ar: اقرأ الويب، والتقط ما يهم، واحفظه بصيغ تملكها.

why.en: Turn scattered reading into a vault your agent can query: clean article extraction, Markdown and Bases, and a canvas for how the pieces connect.
why.ar: حوّل قراءاتك المتفرقة إلى مكتبة يستطيع وكيلك البحث فيها: استخلاص نظيف للمقالات، وMarkdown وBases، ولوحة تربط الأجزاء ببعضها.

tagline.en: Draft with a human in the loop, in a voice that stays yours.
tagline.ar: اكتب بمشاركة إنسان في الحلقة، وبصوت يبقى صوتك.

why.en: Stops the agent from writing at you. Co-authoring turns drafting into a conversation, and the guidelines keep the result in your brand's voice.
why.ar: يمنع الوكيل من الكتابة نحوك. التأليف المشترك يحوّل الصياغة إلى حوار، والإرشادات تُبقي النتيجة بصوت علامتك.

tagline.en: Read, write and repair Word, PDF, PowerPoint and Excel without leaving the chat.
tagline.ar: اقرأ وأنشئ وأصلح ملفات Word وPDF وPowerPoint وExcel دون مغادرة المحادثة.

why.en: Four formats that arrive as attachments and leave as deliverables. Extraction, editing, form filling and OCR, all handled locally.
why.ar: أربع صيغ تصلك كمرفقات وتخرج كمخرجات نهائية. استخلاص وتحرير وتعبئة نماذج وتعرّف ضوئي، كلها تُنفَّذ محلياً.

tagline.en: From a working branch to production: deploy, database and the tuning in between.
tagline.ar: من فرع يعمل إلى الإنتاج: نشر وقاعدة بيانات وما بينهما من ضبط.

why.en: The last mile, where most agent help stops. Deployment flows, Vercel optimisation, and Postgres practices that survive real traffic.
why.ar: الميل الأخير، حيث تتوقف معظم مساعدة الوكلاء. تدفقات النشر، وتحسين Vercel، وممارسات Postgres التي تصمد أمام حركة حقيقية.
